title: Studio-state and CRUD seam map

scope.goal: Identify the next extraction boundary for studio-state, page selection, page CRUD-adjacent state, and component CRUD responsibilities still living in server.js.

state_and_page_routes.responsibility: alias envelope { spec } for client code
lists dist HTML pages and currentPage
mutates currentPage and persists via saveStudio()
aggregates spec, state.json, dist file inventory, approved decisions, and previewUrl

state_helpers.responsibility: hydrates persisted studio session state and validates current_page against dist contents
persists current_page, build state, timestamps, and session metadata

component_crud_routes_still_inline.responsibility: normalize payload, write component files, update library index, sync skill
extract section HTML/CSS variables/fields/slots from current site into a reusable component

existing_module_overlap.risk: server.js still defines overlapping /api/components read/import/export handlers later in the file, creating route-order ambiguity and split ownership under the same prefix

recommended_extraction_order: 1. Extract page/state routes plus listPages/loadStudio/saveStudio-adjacent helpers into a dedicated studio-state-routes module.
2. Extract inline component CRUD/import/export handlers into a dedicated component-crud-routes or expand server/component-routes.js into the single owner of the /api/components prefix.
3. Remove duplicate inline /api/components handlers from server.js only after parity verification, because mount order currently gives the earlier module first claim on matching paths.
4. Add seam tests around GET /api/pages, POST /api/pages/current, GET /api/studio-state, GET /api/components/:id, POST /api/components/import, and POST /api/components/export.
open_seams: currentPage is a module-level mutable singleton referenced far beyond the route area, so extraction must preserve shared authority until websocket and build-context lanes are cut later.
component prefix ownership is already split across server/component-routes.js and inline handlers in server.js.
GET /api/studio-state walks the dist tree directly and packages multiple concerns into one response.
proof_note: Read-only discovery artifact only. No runtime state was mutated to generate this seam map.
